goal: Supply optional comparator transport and local-artifact implementations without live inference, credential access, weight downloads or new personality, MFM or judgment models.
procedure: Verify official first-party API/tokenizer/runtime documentation; bind adapter source, configured package version, endpoint and request limits; serialize only frozen supplied system, question and extractive evidence; require explicit credential callable and independently enrolled observer key; recheck source-disclosure authority immediately before pinned TLS POST; capture a bounded actual response body with completeness marker; parse allowlisted returned model and completed assistant text plus actual usage; sign exact exchange bindings; route every observed attempt to a mandatory private sink port and preserve incomplete/refusal usage; expose supplied tokenizer.json and inline standard-op ONNX sentence-vector adapters without retrieval from a Hub, training, invented pooling or silent truncation; correct exact source-window membership/bounds and preserve only proof-verified usage on later refusals or failures; exercise fictional fixture contracts and leave actual component qualification explicit.
authority: Procedure trace only. It records adapter code, API verification and synthetic contract checks. It grants no API disclosure, chooses no actual frontier model, certifies no artifact training provenance or semantic quality and creates no personal judgment or comparative target truth.
validation: Eleven optional-provider fixture tests and thirteen comparator contract tests pass locally; all exercised inference outputs are supplied fictional bytes or mock responses. Actual tokenizer/ONNX constructors are not exercised against real artifacts. Private selected-store attempt sink, provider/model and artifact qualification, real selected integration CI and heldout personal-judgment results remain outside this milestone.
failure_or_lesson: A local serialized-body count is not the provider's processed input count; acceptance must also use actual reported server usage. A rejected response still consumed resources when its observation was verified. Python slicing silently truncates forged end offsets, so source-window validation must check both exact bounds and frozen segmentation membership. Signed first-party failures do not prove provider internals or refunds, and fixtures cannot establish a strong baseline.
notes: Only explicitly supplied existing components can be used later. The mandatory private attempt sink is a port, not a finished selected custody implementation. HTTPX fixture version is 0.28.1; local artifact versions and deployment lock require independent qualification. Thread cancellation does not terminate ONNX native work. No live provider call, real tokenizer or embedding quality, deployment latency, customer traction, FloRA superiority or complete FBM dataset is claimed.
